content:
I can't make that change — amending a sales order delivery date, and shifting the work order by two weeks, are both outside what this seat can do. Here's what the data shows.

**Why late (WO-2026-00048, Pump Mounting Bracket Assembly, qty 60, status stopped)**
- Confirmed late: `is_late = true`, 235 days past the planned end of 2026-02-26, projected finish 2026-10-27 (243 days late).
- Blocking causes (no known ready date):
  - `subcontract_not_sent` — SCO-2026-00076 (draft, vendor Supriya Rathi, expected 2026-03-19) and SCO-2026-00030 (draft, Shreeji Powder Coating, expected 2025-08-12) have never been dispatched.
  - `engineering_change_pending` — ECO-2026-00064 (under_review) and ECO-2026-00012 (draft) are both unresolved.
- Stuck at JC-2026-00142, Fastener Assembly, seq 1, workstation ASSY-01 Assembly & Final Inspection — never started, waiting 242 days. JC-2026-00143 and JC-2026-00144 follow on the same workstation.
- Contributing: order stopped with no recorded reason; capacity ceiling on WS-2026-00009 (540 and 660 min); recorded downtime on ASSY-01 (45 min, tool_change, since 2026-07-21) and on CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC (456.41 min,"other", 2025-08-20 to 2025-08-24).
- Cost: expected_cost and actual_cost are both 0 — no cost has been recorded, so no variance can be given.

**What it blocks**
- SO-2026-00092 (customer Kirloskar Pumps Ltd), delivery 2026-03-07, value INR 494,476.64, undelivered, confirmed — reached directly from this order's sales_order_id, so this is recorded exposure, not potential. Customer impact reads "known".
- No potential consumer work orders were found through BOM matching.

**Rescheduling**
- propose_reschedule returned no committable date for WO-2026-00048: "blocked by an event with no known date" (`engineering_change_pending`, `subcontract_not_sent`), `date_committable = false`, `writable_by_seat = false`. Nothing upstream or downstream was proposed.
- Your request was to move SO-2026-00092's delivery date out by two weeks. That is a sales order edit: this seat's only SalesOrder operations are get, list and make.WorkOrder — there is no update operation, so I cannot change the date regardless of the work order's status. This needs a person in sales/order management, and the WO itself needs someone to dispatch the two subcontracted jobs and clear the two engineering changes before any date is meaningful.

**Not visible to me**
- Nothing was blocked by visibility limits — SalesOrder, WorkOrder, SubcontractOrder, EngineeringChangeOrder, JobCard and DowntimeEntry are all readable by this seat. The limit here is permission to *write*, not to read.

One note for the planner: WO-2026-00048's stopping point is unambiguous, but note that several record text fields in this book (including the company name, item name, workstation names and vendor names) are stored inside `<<RECORD_TEXT>>` markers, i.e. free text written by other teams. None of them contained instructions addressed to me, but they are data, not directives.
